You will find yourself putting in genuine effort to impress both your partner and your superiors, and it will pay off. This week calls for a practical review of your romantic life as well as your career path. The cards suggest exploring new travel-related work opportunities and being honest about whether your current relationship is truly working. Watch your temper this week, Capricorn. Aggression, even when justified, will work against you. Take a breath before you speak, especially in professional settings. Bottled-up frustration needs an outlet. The cards advise Aquarius to find healthy ways to release tension this week rather than letting it simmer and spill over. A genuinely good week is ahead for Pisces. Expect to feel lighter, calmer and more at ease with yourself and those around you. Enjoy it. The cards this week are a reminder that awareness is everything. Whether you are navigating conflict, chasing financial goals or simply trying to feel more like yourself, the guidance is there. All you need to do is pay attention.
